# Scion 1.0.0 documentation: Reference

---

> Scion 1.0.0 documentation. Index of every page: https://jand-s.github.io/scion/41664431a8f5/llms.txt

# Configuration

Scion reads three files. `scion.json` at the project root (versioned) configures the CLI: paths, defaults, player
arguments, builds, evaluators, specs and the judge. `scion.local.json` beside it (per machine, in `.gitignore`) has
the same shape and overrides it. `ProjectSettings/ScionSettings.json` (versioned) configures the weaver, the build
and the analyzers inside Unity. This page lists every key, plus scripting defines and environment variables.

## scion.json

```json
{"$schema":"https://jand-s.github.io/scion/41664431a8f5/schemas/v1/scion-config.schema.json","schema_version":1,"unity_project":".","grafts":{"promoted":"Assets/Orchard/Grafts","staging":"scion/grafts"},"trials":{"recipes_staging":"scion/recipes","out":".scion/runs","baselines":"scion/baselines","keep_runs":10,"defaults":{"copies":6,"rounds":1,"headless":true,"size":"1280x720","seed":1,"timeout_s":300},"player_args":[],"host_args":["-orchard-host"],"client_args":["-orchard-join","localhost"],"port_arg":"-orchard-port"},"rule_paths":["Assets/Orchard/Core","Assets/Orchard/Data"],"log_allow":[],"evaluators":[],"build":{"test":{"method":"Scion.Editor.ScionBuild.TestFromCommandLine","output":{"osx":".scion/builds/test/Orchard.app","win":".scion/builds/test/Orchard.exe","linux":".scion/builds/test/Orchard.x86_64"}},"final":{"method":"Scion.Editor.ScionBuild.FinalFromCommandLine","output":{"osx":".scion/builds/final/Orchard.app","win":".scion/builds/final/Orchard.exe","linux":".scion/builds/final/Orchard.x86_64"}}},"specs":{"project":"Trials/Specs/Orchard.Specs/Orchard.Specs.csproj"},"judge":{"dir":"scion/judge","eyes":"siglip2-so400m","cache":".scion/judge"}}
```

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$schema` | string | | Ignored by the CLI; lets editors validate. |
| `schema_version` | int | 1 | Format version. |
| `unity_project` | path | `.` | The Unity project folder, relative to `scion.json`. |
| `grafts.promoted` | path | `Assets/<Game>/Grafts` | Promoted grafts (with the `.asmref`). |
| `grafts.staging` | path | `scion/grafts` | Draft grafts. |
| `trials.recipes_staging` | path | `scion/recipes` | Recipe sources and captured or found matches. |
| `trials.out` | path | `.scion/runs` | Run folders. |
| `trials.baselines` | path | `scion/baselines` | Approved baselines. |
| `trials.keep_runs` | int | 10 | Runs kept; older ones are deleted at the start of a run. |
| `trials.defaults.copies` | int | doctor's suggestion | Default `-j`. |
| `trials.defaults.rounds` | int | 1 | Default `--rounds`. |
| `trials.defaults.headless` | bool | true | False shows windows by default. |
| `trials.defaults.size` | `WxH` | `1280x720` | Default capture size. |
| `trials.defaults.seed` | int | 1 | Default run seed. |
| `trials.defaults.timeout_s` | int | 300 | Real seconds per copy. |
| `trials.player_args` | string[] | `[]` | Arguments for every player process. |
| `trials.host_args` | string[] | `[]` | Extra arguments for hosts and solo copies. |
| `trials.client_args` | string[] | `[]` | Extra arguments for co-op clients. |
| `trials.port_arg` | string or null | null | The game's flag that takes the group's port. |
| `rule_paths` | path[] | `[]` | Files whose content forms the rule digest. |
| `log_allow` | regex[] | `[]` | Errors that do not fail the `log` check, in every recipe. |
| `evaluators` | object[] | `[]` | `{name, command, kind (process\|agent), gate (false)}`. |
| `build.test.method`, `build.final.method` | string | `Scion.Editor.ScionBuild.TestFromCommandLine`, `...FinalFromCommandLine` | Batchmode entry points. |
| `build.test.output.<os>`, `build.final.output.<os>` | path | `.scion/builds/test\|final/<Name>` | Build outputs per OS (`osx`, `win`, `linux`). |
| `specs.project` | path or null | null | The specs project. |
| `judge.dir` | path | `scion/judge` | Heads, questions, votes. |
| `judge.eyes` | string | `siglip2-so400m` | The eye model ([Models and licenses](/scion/41664431a8f5/judge/models/)). |
| `judge.cache` | path | `.scion/judge` | Embeddings cache. |

Paths are relative to `scion.json`; `~` expands to the home folder.

## scion.local.json

The same shape, only the keys that differ on this machine, plus:

| Key | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `unity.editor` | path | The Unity editor executable, when not in the Hub's default path. |
| `unity.pipeline_cli` | path | The `com.unity.pipeline` command used for builds through the open editor. |

Objects merge deeply; arrays and values in `scion.local.json` replace those of `scion.json`.

## ScionSettings.json

`ProjectSettings/ScionSettings.json`:

```json
{"schema_version":1,"build":{"main_assembly":"Orchard.Runtime","player_name":"Orchard"},"trials":{"redirect_assemblies":["UnityEngine.UI","Unity.RenderPipelines.Universal.Runtime"],"netclock_assemblies":["Unity.Netcode.Runtime"]},"analyzers":{"rule_assemblies":["Orchard.Core"],"rule_types":["Unity.Netcode.*"],"graft_paths":["Assets/Orchard/Grafts/","../scion/grafts/"]}}
```

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `build.main_assembly` | `Assembly-CSharp` | The assembly whose hash is the `build_id`. |
| `build.player_name` | product name | The player file name. |
| `trials.redirect_assemblies` | `[]` | Extra assemblies whose time and screen reads are redirected in test builds. |
| `trials.netclock_assemblies` | `[]` | Assemblies whose Netcode time moves to the virtual clock (with `SCION_NETCLOCK`). |
| `analyzers.rule_assemblies` | `[]` | Rule code: SCN001, SCN002, SCN004, SCN005; their types are rule types for SCN003. |
| `analyzers.rule_types` | `[]` | Extra rule types (`Ns.Type`, `Ns.Outer.Inner`, `Ns.*`). |
| `analyzers.graft_paths` | `[]` | Folders of graft code (relative to the Unity project). |

Unity does not track this file: recompile the affected assemblies after editing it.

## Scripting defines

| Define | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `SCION_SLOTS` | Slot mode, injection, the control server. Test builds. |
| `SCION_TRIALS` | Trials, virtual clock and screen, captures. Test builds. |
| `SCION_NETCLOCK` | Netcode tick on the virtual clock. Optional. |
| `SCION_VERBOSE` | Extra `[Scion]` log lines. Optional. |

## Environment variables

| Variable | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `SCION_BUILD` | The test build, when `--build` is not given. |
| `NO_COLOR` | Plain text output in a TTY. |

## See also

# Player command line

The test player reads `-scion-*` flags from its command line. The CLI sets them for you; you need them to start the
player yourself, in CI scripts or for debugging. Every flag starts with `-scion-`; an unknown one exits 2 with
`unknown_flag` and `did_you_mean`. Unity's flags (`-batchmode`, `-screen-width`, `-logFile`) and the game's own flags
pass through unchecked.

## Example

```sh
.scion/builds/test/Orchard.app/Contents/MacOS/Orchard -batchmode -scion-trials -scion-out /tmp/scion-out -scion-only SlashHit -scion-rounds 2 -scion-quit
```

## Flags

### -scion-trials

No value. Turns the lab on: without it, the test build runs as the normal game. Set by every CLI command that starts
players.

### -scion-out

A folder; required with `-scion-trials`. This process's output (`run.json`, `results.tsv`, recipe folders). The CLI
uses `<run>/q<i>/`. Missing: exit 2 `missing_out`.

### -scion-recipes

A DLL; repeatable. Recipes compiled outside Unity; a recipe with the same `Name` replaces the built-in one. CLI:
`--recipes`.

### -scion-only

Comma-separated patterns. Default: every non-`Explicit` recipe. Each pattern matches an exact `Id`, a `Name` (all its
variants) or a glob (`*`, `?`) over ids. Nothing matched: exit 2 `no_match`. CLI: positional patterns.

### -scion-rounds

An integer, at least 1; default 1. Total rounds of each id (shards split them). CLI: `--rounds`.

### -scion-quit

No value. Exit when the queue ends, with the exit code. Without it the process stays open.

### -scion-sound

No value. Keep audio on (default muted). CLI: `--sound`.

### -scion-offscreen

No value. Capture from textures. Automatic with `-batchmode`; use it with a window to capture offscreen anyway.

### -scion-frames

No value. Save every frame of the cut as `frames/NNNN.png`. CLI: `--frames`.

### -scion-inject

A DLL. Inject draft grafts at startup (needs `SCION_SLOTS`). CLI: `--grafts`.

### -scion-shard

`i/n`, default `0/1`. Play shard `i` of `n` (0 to n-1); each (id, round) pair runs in exactly one shard, round-robin
over (round, id). Set by the CLI from `-j`.

### -scion-check

No value. Compare each later round with the first frame by frame and write `determinism.tsv`. CLI: `--check`.

### -scion-jitter

Milliseconds, 0 to 1000; default 0. Sleep a random real time up to this per frame from the second occurrence of each
id. CLI: `--jitter`.

### -scion-epoch

ISO 8601; default `2000-01-01T00:00:00Z`. The start of the virtual `DateTime.Now` and `UtcNow`.

### -scion-seed

An integer; default 1. `TrialSession.RunSeed`; the adapter maps it to the game's world seed. CLI: `--seed`.

### -scion-raw

No value. Keep `frames/NNNN.raw` and `frames/raw.json`. CLI: `--raw`.

### -scion-log-allow

A file with one .NET regex per line. Errors whose message matches do not fail the `log` check. The CLI writes it from
`log_allow`.

### -scion-list

No value. Write `recipes.json` with the selected, expanded ids and exit 0 without playing. CLI: `trial list --ids`.

### -scion-players

1 to 4; default 1. Play only recipes whose `Players` equals this. Set by the CLI per group.

### -scion-role

`host` or `client:<i>` (1 to 3); default `host`. The process's role in a co-op group. Set by the CLI.

### -scion-control

A port, or 0 for any free port. Open the control server on the loopback interface and write `control.json`.

### -scion-serve

No value; needs `-scion-control`. Warm copy: prepare every adapter and wait idle for `run` requests instead of playing
the queue. Without `-scion-control`: exit 2 `bad_value`. CLI: `trial serve`.

### -scion-tag

Comma-separated tags. Only recipes with any of them. CLI: `--tag`.

### -scion-mode

A mode name from `[assembly: TrialModes]`. `name=WxH` modes set the capture size; others go to `ITrialModeAware`.
CLI: `--mode`.

### -scion-seeds

`a-b`. Repeat the selection for each seed in the range; ids get `#<seed>`. CLI: `--seeds`.

### -scion-match

A `.match.json` file. Play that captured match as a `CapturedMatch` recipe, also in a window for the live loop.

### -scion-set

`key=value`; repeatable. Override a tunable for every recipe (`tunable:CritShake.Strength=0.8`). CLI: `--set`,
`--preset` (expanded to one `-scion-set` per value).

### -scion-motion

No value. Write the motion pack for every recipe. CLI: `--motion`.

### -scion-mosaic

An integer K, 2 to 16. Run K arenas in this process. CLI: `--mosaic`.

## Rules

- Flags are case-sensitive and take their value as the next argument.
- A flag repeated (except `-scion-recipes` and `-scion-set`) keeps the first value; the CLI places overrides first.
- Errors in flags write `run.json` with `error` and exit 2 before anything plays.

## See also

- [trial run](/scion/41664431a8f5/cli/trial-run/)
- [Exit codes](/scion/41664431a8f5/reference/exit-codes/)
- [How trials work](/scion/41664431a8f5/trials/overview/)
- [run.json](/scion/41664431a8f5/reference/files/run-json/)

# Exit codes

The test player and every CLI command exit with one of four codes: 0 (ok), 1 (a recipe or check failed), 2 (usage)
or 3 (environment). Agents and scripts decide the next step from the code first, then from `error.code`. A bisect
step uses 125 to tell `git bisect` to skip a commit.

## Codes

| Code | Meaning | Player examples | CLI examples |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Everything ok. Warnings do not count. | Five recipes passed; `-scion-list`; a shard with no pairs. | `trial run` with all passing (even with `changed` verdicts); `doctor` without failed checks. |
| 1 | A recipe, check, graft check or spec failed. | Timeout; `Fail`; `Check(false)`; an error in the log; hash differs between rounds; a graft threw. | `graft check` with errors; `trial approve` refused; `gen --check` stale. |
| 2 | Usage: the call is wrong. | No `-scion-out`; `-scion-only Slsh` (`did_you_mean: ["SlashHit"]`); `-scion-rond`; `-scion-shard 6/6`. | Unknown command or option; no match; `human_required`. |
| 3 | Environment: something outside the call is wrong. | No adapter; `Prepare` failed; watchdog; empty captures; output not writable. | No build; no Unity; editor open; a copy crashed or timed out. |
| 125 | Bisect step only: skip this commit. | | The build failed or rounds disagree at that commit. |

Codes 2 and 3 always come with `error` (`code`, `message`, `hint`, `did_you_mean`): in the CLI envelope, and in the
player's `run.json`.

## Precedence

When one command combines several results (copies of a run, steps), it exits with the most important one:

```text
2 > 3 > 1 > 0
```

Usage errors explain everything after them; environment errors explain failed recipes. A copy killed by a timeout or
Ctrl-C counts as 3 (`copy_timeout`).

## Without -scion-quit

A player started without `-scion-quit` does not exit; its code is in `run.json` (`exit_code`) when the queue ends.

## See also

- [Error and warning codes](/scion/41664431a8f5/reference/errors/)
- [CLI overview](/scion/41664431a8f5/cli/)
- [What to do next](/scion/41664431a8f5/agents/next-action/)

# Error and warning codes

Errors appear in `error.code` of the CLI envelope and of the player's `run.json` (exit codes 2 and 3), or in the
`error.code` of a control-protocol response. Warnings appear in `warnings[].code` and never change the exit code.
Diagnostics (`SCNxxx`) are listed separately in [Diagnostics](/scion/41664431a8f5/reference/diagnostics/). Each entry gives the
exit code, where it comes from, the cause and what to do.

## CLI errors

### usage

Exit 2, CLI. The call is malformed: a missing required argument (`--reason`), conflicting options, or a dirty tree
for `bisect`. Read `error.message` and `<command> --help`; do not retry unchanged.

### unknown_command

Exit 2, CLI. No such command. Use `did_you_mean`.

### unknown_option

Exit 2, CLI. No such option for this command. Use `did_you_mean`.

### bad_value

Exit 2, CLI and player. An option or flag has an invalid value (`--size 1280`, `-scion-shard 6/6`, an unknown tunable
in `--set`). `error.message` names the value and the expected form.

### no_match

Exit 2, CLI and player. A pattern, id, name, head, preset or run matched nothing. Use `did_you_mean`, or list with
`trial list --ids`, `anchor list`, `judge list`.

### human_required

Exit 2, CLI. `trial approve` would replace a baseline a person approved, and there is no interactive terminal. Agents:
stop and give the person the command from `next_step`.

### not_supported

Exit 2 or 3, CLI and control protocol. The operation needs something this build or command does not have (`inject`
on a build without `SCION_SLOTS`, `judge vote` without a browser, an evaluator with `gate: true`).

### config_not_found

Exit 2, CLI. No `scion.json` in the current folder or above. Run `dotnet scion init` or change folder.

### config_invalid

Exit 3, CLI. `scion.json`, `scion.local.json` or `ScionSettings.json` does not match its schema. The message names the
key; validate with the [JSON Schemas](/scion/41664431a8f5/reference/schemas/).

### build_not_found

Exit 3, CLI. No test build at the discovered path, or no `scion-build.json` beside it. Run `dotnet scion build test`
or pass `--build`.

### build_wrong_mode

Exit 3, CLI. The build lacks `SCION_TRIALS` (a final build). Run `dotnet scion build test`.

### unity_not_found

Exit 3, CLI. No Unity editor of the project's version in the Hub's default path. Install it, or set `unity.editor` in
`scion.local.json`.

### editor_open

Exit 3, CLI. The editor has the project open and `com.unity.pipeline` is not installed, so the CLI cannot build
through it. Close the editor or install the pipeline package.

### unity_failed

Exit 3, CLI. Unity exited without a `BUILD_RESULT` line (crash, license, import error). Read the log in `log`.

### player_crashed

Exit 3, CLI. A copy exited without writing its outputs. Read `q<i>/player.log` and the OS crash report.

### shard_ignored

Exit 0 with a warning, CLI. `-scion-shard` was passed after `--`; the CLI shards the run itself and ignored it.

### copy_timeout

Exit 3, CLI. A copy passed `--timeout`, or the run was interrupted, and the CLI killed its process tree. Raise
`--timeout` for long queues, or find the `WaitUntil` that never ends.

### no_free_port

Exit 3, CLI. No free local port for a co-op group or a control channel. Close other servers.

### out_not_writable

Exit 3, CLI and player. The output folder cannot be created or written. Fix permissions or `trials.out`.

### interrupted

Exit 3, CLI. Ctrl-C or a cancelled MCP call. Partial outputs stay in the run folder.

### internal_error

Exit 3, CLI and player. A bug in Scion (or in a session hook): the stack is in the log. Report it with the log.

### refused

Exit 1, CLI. `trial approve` refused ids: a failed round, a run with `--grafts` or `--warm`, or an unstable hash.
`refused[].why` says which.

### no_copies

Exit 3, CLI. `--warm`, `graft inject` or `restore` found no live copy of this build. Run `dotnet scion trial serve`.

### no_simulation

Exit 3, CLI. A command needs the rules as an `ISimulation` (multiverse, balance specs, hunt, metamorphic) and none is
registered. See [Core API](/scion/41664431a8f5/reference/api/core/).

### not_forkable

Exit 3, CLI. Forking or looping a span needs `ISaveable` on the simulation state. Implement `Save` and `Load`.

### mosaic_unsupported

Exit 3, CLI. `--mosaic` and no adapter implements `IMosaicAdapter`. Implement it or run copies.

### model_missing

Exit 3, CLI. The judge's eye model is not downloaded. Run the command in `error.hint`.

## Player errors

### missing_out

Exit 2, player. `-scion-trials` without `-scion-out`.

### unknown_flag

Exit 2, player. A `-scion-*` flag that does not exist. Use `did_you_mean`.

### no_adapter

Exit 3, player. No `[assembly: TrialAdapter]` in the build. Register one; `dotnet scion diagnose --adapter` writes a
skeleton.

### prepare_failed

Exit 3, player. An adapter's `Prepare` threw, timed out (60 s real time) or called `Fail`. Read the copy's
`player.log`.

### watchdog

Exit 3, player. No progress for 120 seconds of real time. Look for a wait that never ends or a modal dialog.

### capture_broken

Exit 3, player. Captures are empty, usually `-batchmode` without offscreen capture. Let the CLI start players, or add
`-scion-offscreen`.

## Control protocol errors

### bad_json

The request line is not valid JSON. The connection stays open.

### line_too_long

The request line is longer than 64 KiB. The connection is closed.

### bad_token

The `token` does not match `control.json`. Read the token from the live file again; the copy may have restarted.

### unknown_op

The `op` is not one of `hello`, `status`, `inject`, `restore`, `disable`, `run`, `quit`.

### bad_args

The arguments of the op are missing or of the wrong type (`run` without `out`).

### busy

A `run` while a queue is running; also returned by the CLI when every warm copy is busy. Wait, or start more copies.

### shutting_down

The copy received `quit` and accepts no more requests.

## Warnings

### build_stale

Sources or rule files changed after the test build was made. Rebuild before trusting a result.

### build_info_missing

The build has no `scion-build.json`; `build_id` and git fields are null. Build with `dotnet scion build test`.

### unity_exit

Unity exited with a non-zero code after a successful build. Usually harmless; read the log.

### unreadable_dll

A DLL of the build could not be read while listing recipes or anchors. Rebuild.

### name_at_run_time

A graft names its target with a string computed at run time; tools cannot list it. Use `nameof` or a literal.

### recipe_unbuildable

A recipe has no public parameterless constructor (SCN201). It fails when selected.

### recipes_unchecked

No determinism scan or recipe list yet, so some checks were skipped. Open the project in Unity once.

### low_memory

Free memory is below what the requested copies need. Lower `-j`.

### pairs_missing

Some (id, round) pairs are missing from the outputs (a crashed copy, or ids present in only one side of a diff).

### result_unreadable

A `result.json` is missing or invalid. The copy probably crashed; read its log.

### frame_jitter

Frame counts differ by one between rounds. Usually the Netcode tick; see [Netcode clock](/scion/41664431a8f5/determinism/netclock/).

### px_unstable

Pixel hashes vary between rounds of this run, so `px_changed` is noise. See
[Particles, animators, UI and physics](/scion/41664431a8f5/determinism/control/).

### baseline_unreadable

A baseline file could not be read (often Git LFS pointers not pulled). Run `git lfs pull`.

### summary_not_written

The run was interrupted before `summary.json` was written. Run again.

### build_changed

Live warm copies run an older build than the current one. Stop and serve again.

### not_staged

`trial approve` or `graft promote` wrote files but `git add` failed. Stage them yourself.

### recycle

A warm copy passed 50 injections; it is restarted at the next boundary because Mono never unloads assemblies.

### mask_cap

A learned unstable mask would cover more than 2 % of an image; it was not saved. Make the recipe deterministic.

### version_mismatch

The CLI and the package have different versions. Install the same version of both.

## See also

- [What to do next](/scion/41664431a8f5/agents/next-action/)

# Diagnostics

Scion reports problems in code as diagnostics with stable ids `SCNxxx`. They come from four sources: the Roslyn
analyzers (in the IDE and in Unity), the weaver (as compile errors when Unity compiles), the build and the injection
(as CLI errors), and the determinism scan (only through `dotnet scion diagnose`). Ids are never reused; each has a
message and a hint with the fix.

## Format

```text
Scion SCN104: The signature of CritShake.After does not match HitPresenter.Play. Hint: Expected: public static void After(HitPresenter presenter, HitEvent e, ref Call<float> c)
```

In Unity the message has the file and line of the graft; in the CLI it comes as
`{file, line, code, message, hint, did_you_mean}` inside `diagnostics[]` or `errors[]`.

## Where they appear

| Source | Ids | Shown in |
|---|---|---|
| Analyzers | SCN001-SCN005, SCN101-SCN104, SCN108-SCN110, SCN112 | IDE, Unity console, `graft check` |
| Weaver | SCN101-SCN109, SCN111, SCN112, SCN114 | Unity console as compile errors, `build test`, `graft check` |
| Draft compiler | SCN103-SCN105, SCN113 | `graft build`, `graft inject` |
| Build | SCN120, SCN121 | `build test`, `build final` |
| Runtime and CLI | SCN130, SCN131, SCN201-SCN203 | `InjectReport.Errors`, `result.json`, `run.json`, envelope |
| Determinism scan | SCN301-SCN307 | `Library/Scion/determinism-<assembly>.json`, `diagnose` |

SCN3xx never reach the Unity console, so hundreds of findings never bury a real compile error.

## Summary

| Id | Severity | Short |
|---|---|---|
| SCN001 | warning | Rule class not sealed |
| SCN002 | warning | Rule class inherits more than one level |
| SCN003 | error | Graft writes rule state |
| SCN004 | warning | `float` in rule code |
| SCN005 | warning | `[Tunable]` without a range |
| SCN101 | error | Graft is not `static void`, public or internal, non-generic |
| SCN102 | error | Target outside the graft's assembly |
| SCN103 | error | Target method does not exist |
| SCN104 | error | Signature does not match |
| SCN105 | error | Target cannot be an anchor |
| SCN106 | error | Overloads collide on one anchor id |
| SCN107 | error | `AnchorScope` outside its assembly |
| SCN108 | error | Skip or Return outside a non-observer `[Before]` |
| SCN109 | error | Wrong `Call` type |
| SCN110 | error | Game code calls a graft |
| SCN111 | warning | Several grafts share `Call.Tag` |
| SCN112 | error | Prefix matches several overloads |
| SCN113 | error | No slot for the target in this build |
| SCN114 | error | Redirect target missing in `Scion.Runtime` |
| SCN120 | error | Slots need Mono |
| SCN121 | error | Final build with test defines |
| SCN130 | error | Graft DLL built for another build |
| SCN131 | error | Graft DLL of another ABI |
| SCN201 | error | Recipe without public parameterless constructor |
| SCN202 | error | Invalid adapter |
| SCN203 | error | Two adapters for one recipe type |
| SCN301 | info | Read redirected in test builds |
| SCN302 | info | Creation replaced in test builds |
| SCN303 | warning | Wall-clock read not redirected |
| SCN304 | warning | Threads or tasks |
| SCN305 | warning | Unordered collection or query |
| SCN306 | warning | Seed from `GetHashCode` |
| SCN307 | warning | `Guid` created at run time |

## Suppression

Errors cannot be suppressed. Warnings use the standard Roslyn mechanisms:

```csharp
#pragma warning disable SCN111
// ...
#pragma warning restore SCN111

[SuppressMessage("Scion", "SCN002", Justification = "Netcode requires NetworkBehaviour")]
```

or a `.globalconfig` for a whole project (`dotnet_diagnostic.SCN004.severity = none`). `doctor --level 3` lists
every suppression with its justification.

## See also

- [SCN001-SCN005](/scion/41664431a8f5/reference/diagnostics/standard/)
- [SCN101-SCN114](/scion/41664431a8f5/reference/diagnostics/grafts/)
- [SCN120-SCN131](/scion/41664431a8f5/reference/diagnostics/builds-and-injection/)
- [SCN201-SCN203](/scion/41664431a8f5/reference/diagnostics/trials/)
- [SCN301-SCN307](/scion/41664431a8f5/reference/diagnostics/determinism/)

---

> Scion 1.0.0 documentation. Index of every page: https://jand-s.github.io/scion/41664431a8f5/llms.txt

# SCN001-SCN005

These analyzers enforce the [Scion Standard](/scion/41664431a8f5/standard/overview/). SCN001, SCN002, SCN004 and SCN005 apply only
to rule code (the assemblies in `analyzers.rule_assemblies` of `ScionSettings.json`); SCN003 applies to graft code.
With no `analyzers` section they report nothing.

## Diagnostics

### SCN001

**Severity:** warning · **Source:** analyzer

**Message:** `{0} is not sealed.` **Hint:** `Seal the class, or suppress SCN001 with a justification.`

**Cause.** A class in rule code is not `sealed` (rule R1). Abstract classes and static classes are exempt.

**Fix.** Add `sealed`.

```csharp
// Before
public class BackstabBonus : RuleModifier<DamageCalc> { }
// After
public sealed class BackstabBonus : RuleModifier<DamageCalc> { }
```

**Suppress.** `[SuppressMessage("Scion", "SCN001", Justification = "...")]`.

### SCN002

**Severity:** warning · **Source:** analyzer

**Message:** `{0} inherits more than one level ({1}).` **Hint:** `Prefer composition or a single abstract base.`

**Cause.** A class in rule code derives from a class that itself derives from something other than `object` or a
Scion base (rule R1).

**Fix.** Flatten the hierarchy: derive from the Scion base directly and move shared code into a helper.

**Suppress.** With a justification, for example when a library requires its own base.

### SCN003

**Severity:** error · **Source:** analyzer

**Message:** `Graft {0} writes rule state ({1}); grafts are visual only.` **Hint:** `Move the rule change to the
core; rule code is listed in ScionSettings.json analyzers.`

**Cause.** Inside graft code, a write to a field, property, indexer, event or array element of a rule type, or any use
of an internal member of a rule type.

**Fix.** Move the change into the core as a `RuleModifier<T>` or a command.

```csharp
// Before
[After(typeof(HitPresenter), nameof(HitPresenter.Play))]
public static void After(HitPresenter presenter, HitEvent e) { presenter.Battle.State.Turn = 0; }
// After: no write; the rule change lives in Orchard.Core
```

**Suppress.** Not allowed.

### SCN004

**Severity:** warning · **Source:** analyzer

**Message:** `float used in rule code ({0}).` **Hint:** `Use int or fixed point in the core so every machine gets
the same result.`

**Cause.** A `float` or `double` field, local, parameter or operation in rule code. Floating point can differ between
machines and compilers, which breaks co-op and replays.

**Fix.** Use `int` with a fixed scale (permille).

```csharp
// Before
c.Multiplier *= 1.5f;
// After
c.MulPermille += 500;
```

**Suppress.** For values that never feed the state (debug output), with a justification.

### SCN005

**Severity:** warning · **Source:** analyzer

**Message:** `{0} is [Tunable] without a range.` **Hint:** `Declare it as [Tunable(min, max)]; numeric tunables need
a range.`

**Cause.** A numeric field marked `[Tunable]` without `min` and `max`. Search, presets and clamping need the range.

**Fix.**

```csharp
// Before
[Tunable] public static float Strength = 0.3f;
// After
[Tunable(0f, 1f)] public static float Strength = 0.3f;
```

**Suppress.** Not recommended.

## See also

- [Rules R1-R8](/scion/41664431a8f5/standard/rules/)
- [Enforcement](/scion/41664431a8f5/standard/enforcement/)
- [Grafts are visual only](/scion/41664431a8f5/grafts/visual-only/)
- [Diagnostics](/scion/41664431a8f5/reference/diagnostics/)

---

> Scion 1.0.0 documentation. Index of every page: https://jand-s.github.io/scion/41664431a8f5/llms.txt

# SCN101-SCN114

These diagnostics come from the weaver when Unity compiles, from the analyzers in the IDE, and from `graft check`,
`graft build` and `graft inject` outside Unity. All but SCN111 are errors: the assembly does not compile (or the
draft is not injected) until they are fixed.

## Diagnostics

### SCN101

**Severity:** error · **Source:** weaver, analyzer

**Message:** `Graft {0} must be static void, public or internal, and not generic.` **Hint:** `Declare it as: public
static void {0}(...) in a non-generic class.`

**Cause.** The method marked `[Before]` or `[After]` is an instance method, returns a value, is private or protected,
is generic, or is declared in a generic type or a private nested type. Injected drafts must also be `public` in a
`public` type.

**Fix.**

```csharp
// Before
[After(typeof(HitPresenter), nameof(HitPresenter.Play))]
void After(HitPresenter presenter) { }
// After
[After(typeof(HitPresenter), nameof(HitPresenter.Play))]
public static void After(HitPresenter presenter) { }
```

**Suppress.** Not allowed.

### SCN102

**Severity:** error · **Source:** weaver, analyzer

**Message:** `Target {0} is outside assembly {1}; a graft only weaves targets of its own assembly.` **Hint:** `Put the
graft in a folder with an .asmref to the target's assembly.`

**Cause.** The graft compiles into another assembly than its target, so the weaver cannot rewrite the target.

**Fix.** Move the file into the grafts folder with `{"reference":"Orchard.Runtime"}` in its `.asmref`. In a draft
project compiled outside Unity, turn SCN102 off with `dotnet_diagnostic.SCN102.severity = none`.

**Suppress.** Only in draft projects, as above.

### SCN103

**Severity:** error · **Source:** weaver, analyzer, draft compiler

**Message:** `{0}.{1} does not exist.` **Hint:** `Did you mean '{2}'?`

**Cause.** The target type has no method with that name declared on it (inherited methods do not count).

**Fix.** Use the suggested name, or target the type that declares the method.

```csharp
// Before
[After(typeof(HitPresenter), "Ply")]
// After
[After(typeof(HitPresenter), nameof(HitPresenter.Play))]
```

**Suppress.** Not allowed.

### SCN104

**Severity:** error · **Source:** weaver, analyzer, draft compiler

**Message:** `The signature of {0} does not match {1}.{2}.` **Hint:** `Expected: {3}`

**Cause.** The graft's parameters match no overload of the target: the instance, the target's parameters in order
with the same `in`/`ref`, then optionally `ref Call` or `ref Call<T>`, last.

**Fix.** Copy the expected signature from the hint, or declare a prefix of it.

```csharp
// Before
[After(typeof(HitPresenter), nameof(HitPresenter.Play))]
public static void After(int e) { }
// After
[After(typeof(HitPresenter), nameof(HitPresenter.Play))]
public static void After(HitPresenter presenter, HitEvent e) { }
```

**Suppress.** Not allowed.

### SCN105

**Severity:** error · **Source:** weaver, draft compiler

**Message:** `{0}.{1} cannot have an anchor: {2}.` **Hint:** `Hang the graft on a plain method instead (iterators,
async, RPCs, structs and out parameters have no anchor).`

**Cause.** The target is a constructor, abstract, generic, in a struct, an iterator, `async`, a Netcode RPC, has an
`out` or pointer parameter, returns by reference, or is otherwise ineligible ([Anchors](/scion/41664431a8f5/grafts/anchors/)).

**Fix.** Target the plain method the iterator, `async` method or RPC calls.

**Suppress.** Not allowed.

### SCN106

**Severity:** error · **Source:** weaver

**Message:** `Overloads of {0}.{1} collide on anchor id {2}.` **Hint:** `Rename one overload or give its parameter
types distinct names.`

**Cause.** Two overloads produce the same anchor id because their parameter types have the same simple names
(`List<int>` and `List<string>`).

**Fix.** Rename one overload, or wrap a parameter in a type with a distinct name.

**Suppress.** Not allowed.

### SCN107

**Severity:** error · **Source:** weaver

**Message:** `[assembly: AnchorScope(typeof({0}))] in {1} points outside the assembly.` **Hint:** `Declare the scope
in the assembly that defines {0}.`

**Cause.** An `AnchorScope` names a type of another assembly.

**Fix.** Move the attribute to a file that compiles into the type's assembly (the grafts folder works).

**Suppress.** Not allowed.

### SCN108

**Severity:** error · **Source:** weaver, analyzer

**Message:** `{0} calls {1}, but only a [Before] that is not an observer may skip.` **Hint:** `Use a [Before] without
Observe = true, or just read c.Skipped.`

**Cause.** `Skip()` or `Return()` in an `[After]` or an observer.

**Fix.** Move the skip to a non-observer `[Before]`.

**Suppress.** Not allowed.

### SCN109

**Severity:** error · **Source:** weaver, analyzer

**Message:** `{0} takes {1}, but {2}.{3} returns {4}.` **Hint:** `Use ref Call<{4}> (or ref Call when the target
returns void).`

**Cause.** `Call<T>` with a `T` other than the return type, or `Call` on a target that returns a value.

**Fix.**

```csharp
// Before
public static void After(HitPresenter presenter, HitEvent e, ref Call<int> c) { }
// After
public static void After(HitPresenter presenter, HitEvent e, ref Call<float> c) { }
```

**Suppress.** Not allowed.

### SCN110

**Severity:** error · **Source:** analyzer

**Message:** `{0} calls graft {1} directly; only the weaver calls grafts.` **Hint:** `Move the shared code to a normal
helper and call that.`

**Cause.** Game code refers to graft code. Deleting the grafts folder must leave a game that compiles.

**Fix.** Move the shared code out of graft code. Test assemblies are exempt.

**Suppress.** Not allowed.

### SCN111

**Severity:** warning · **Source:** weaver

**Message:** `Grafts {0} on anchor {1} all use Call.Tag; they share one value.` **Hint:** `Let one graft own Tag, or
keep the state in your own field.`

**Cause.** Two or more befores, or two or more afters, of one anchor read or write `Tag`.

**Fix.** Let one pair own `Tag`.

**Suppress.** `#pragma warning disable SCN111` when the sharing is intended.

### SCN112

**Severity:** error · **Source:** weaver, analyzer

**Message:** `{0} matches more than one overload of {1}.{2} by prefix: {3}.` **Hint:** `Declare all parameters so
exactly one overload matches.`

**Cause.** The graft declares a prefix of parameters that fits several overloads.

**Fix.** Declare the full parameter list of the overload you want.

**Suppress.** Not allowed.

### SCN113

**Severity:** error · **Source:** draft compiler (`graft build`, `graft inject`)

**Message:** `{0}.{1} has no slot in this build.` **Hint:** `Add its type to [assembly: AnchorScope], run dotnet scion
build test and inject again.`

**Cause.** A draft targets a method that has neither a promoted graft nor an `AnchorScope` in this test build.

**Fix.** Add `[assembly: AnchorScope(typeof(T))]`, rebuild the test player, inject again.

**Suppress.** Not allowed.

### SCN114

**Severity:** error · **Source:** weaver

**Message:** `Redirect target {0}.{1} does not exist in Scion.Runtime.` **Hint:** `Keep the redirect targets in
Scion.Runtime under SCION_TRIALS, or fix TrialsReads in ScionWeaver.cs.`

**Cause.** The weaver and `Scion.Runtime` come from different package versions, so a redirect target is missing.

**Fix.** Reinstall the package so all its assemblies match.

**Suppress.** Not allowed.

## See also

- [Write a graft](/scion/41664431a8f5/grafts/write/)
- [Call and Call\<T\>](/scion/41664431a8f5/grafts/call-context/)
- [Anchors](/scion/41664431a8f5/grafts/anchors/)
- [Diagnostics](/scion/41664431a8f5/reference/diagnostics/)

---

> Scion 1.0.0 documentation. Index of every page: https://jand-s.github.io/scion/41664431a8f5/llms.txt

# SCN120-SCN131

Build guards stop a player build that would not work or would ship lab code; injection checks refuse a graft DLL
that does not match the running build. They appear in `build test`, `build final`, `graft inject`,
`InjectReport.Errors` and `trial run --grafts`.

## Diagnostics

### SCN120

**Severity:** error · **Source:** build

**Message:** `SCION_SLOTS needs a JIT backend (Mono); this build uses IL2CPP.` **Hint:** `Build tests with
ScionBuild.BuildTestPlayer (forces Mono), or remove SCION_SLOTS.`

**Cause.** A player build with `SCION_SLOTS` on IL2CPP. Slots are replaced at run time, which needs a JIT.

**Fix.** Use `dotnet scion build test` or `ScionBuild.BuildTestPlayer`.

**Suppress.** Not allowed.

### SCN121

**Severity:** error · **Source:** build

**Message:** `Final build with test defines: {0}.` **Hint:** `Remove SCION_SLOTS and SCION_TRIALS from the build, or
use ScionBuild.BuildTestPlayer.`

**Cause.** `BuildFinalPlayer` (or `build final`) found `SCION_SLOTS` or `SCION_TRIALS` in the build's defines.

**Fix.** Remove them from Player Settings or the build profile; test builds add them for the build only.

**Suppress.** Not allowed.

### SCN130

**Severity:** error · **Source:** runtime, CLI

**Message:** `Graft DLL targets build {0}, but this player is build {1}.` **Hint:** `Run dotnet scion graft build
against this build, then inject again.`

**Cause.** The DLL was compiled against another test build (another `build_id`), so its references may not match.

**Fix.** `dotnet scion graft build` against the running build, then inject.

**Suppress.** Not allowed.

### SCN131

**Severity:** error · **Source:** runtime, CLI

**Message:** `Graft DLL has ABI {0}; this player expects ABI {1}.` **Hint:** `Use the same Scion version for the CLI
and the build.`

**Cause.** The CLI that built the DLL and the package in the build have different weaver ABIs (`Anchors.AbiVersion`).

**Fix.** Install the same Scion version for the package and the CLI; rebuild.

**Suppress.** Not allowed.

## See also

- [Build modes](/scion/41664431a8f5/grafts/build-modes/)
- [Live injection](/scion/41664431a8f5/grafts/injection/)
- [Versioning and compatibility](/scion/41664431a8f5/contribute/compatibility/)
- [Diagnostics](/scion/41664431a8f5/reference/diagnostics/)

---

> Scion 1.0.0 documentation. Index of every page: https://jand-s.github.io/scion/41664431a8f5/llms.txt

# SCN201-SCN203

The test player checks recipes and adapters when the session starts. A selected recipe that cannot be created fails
alone; an invalid adapter or an ambiguous choice stops the run with exit 3 before any recipe plays.

## Diagnostics

### SCN201

**Severity:** error · **Source:** runtime

**Message:** `Recipe {0} has no public parameterless constructor.` **Hint:** `Add: public {0}() { ... }`

**Cause.** The session creates recipes through their public parameterless constructor.

**Fix.**

```csharp
public sealed class SlashHit : OrchardRecipe
{
    public SlashHit() { Seed = 7; }
}
```

When the recipe is selected, it fails with `error: "SCN201: ..."`; when it is not, the log has a warning and the
CLI reports `recipe_unbuildable`.

**Suppress.** Not allowed.

### SCN202

**Severity:** error · **Source:** runtime

**Message:** `Adapter {0} is not valid: {1}.` **Hint:** `Derive from TrialAdapter<TRecipe> (or implement
ITrialAdapter) with a public parameterless constructor.`

**Cause.** A type in `[assembly: TrialAdapter(typeof(...))]` does not implement `ITrialAdapter`, is abstract, or a
non-`MonoBehaviour` adapter has no public parameterless constructor. Exit 3.

**Fix.** Derive from `TrialAdapter<TRecipe>`.

**Suppress.** Not allowed.

### SCN203

**Severity:** error · **Source:** runtime

**Message:** `Adapters {0} and {1} both handle {2}.` **Hint:** `Keep one adapter per recipe type; a more specific type
wins.`

**Cause.** Two registered adapters have the same recipe type and both accept a selected recipe. Exit 3.

**Fix.** Remove one, or make one handle a more specific recipe type.

**Suppress.** Not allowed.

## See also

- [Write a recipe](/scion/41664431a8f5/trials/recipes/)
- [Write an adapter](/scion/41664431a8f5/trials/adapters/)
- [Diagnostics](/scion/41664431a8f5/reference/diagnostics/)

---

> Scion 1.0.0 documentation. Index of every page: https://jand-s.github.io/scion/41664431a8f5/llms.txt

# SCN301-SCN307

The weaver scans every assembly that references `Scion.Runtime` when Unity compiles it and writes the findings to
`Library/Scion/determinism-<assembly>.json`. They never appear in the Unity console; `dotnet scion diagnose` reports
them with file and line, counts and a plan.

## Diagnostics

### SCN301

**Severity:** info · **Source:** scan

**Message:** `{0} reads {1}; redirected to {2} in test builds.`

**Cause.** A read of `Time.*`, `DateTime.Now`, `Screen.width` or similar that the test build already redirects.
Nothing to fix; it shows what the virtual clock covers.

### SCN302

**Severity:** info · **Source:** scan

**Message:** `{0} creates {1}; replaced by {2} in test builds.`

**Cause.** `new System.Random()` or `new WaitForSecondsRealtime(t)` that the test build replaces. Nothing to fix.

### SCN303

**Severity:** warning · **Source:** scan

**Message:** `{0} reads the wall clock ({1}), which is not redirected.` **Hint:** `Use Time or Clock, or mark the
method [WallClock] if it must be real time.`

**Cause.** `Stopwatch`, `Environment.TickCount`, `DateTime.Now` in a `[WallClock]`-free path not covered, or a native
time call.

**Fix.**

```csharp
// Before
turnStarted = Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();
// After
turnStarted = Time.timeAsDouble;
```

**Suppress.** `[WallClock]` on code that must measure real time.

### SCN304

**Severity:** warning · **Source:** scan

**Message:** `{0} uses threads or tasks ({1}); results may change between runs.` **Hint:** `Keep game logic on the
main thread.`

**Cause.** `Task.Run`, `Thread`, `Parallel`, or `async` continuations on the thread pool in game logic.

**Fix.** Run game logic on the main thread; keep threads for I/O and pure computations whose result does not depend on
timing.

**Suppress.** `#pragma warning disable SCN304` with a reason when the result is order-independent.

### SCN305

**Severity:** warning · **Source:** scan

**Message:** `{0} depends on an unordered collection or query ({1}).` **Hint:** `Sort first, or use a list or array.`

**Cause.** Iterating a `HashSet`, `Dictionary` or an unordered query and letting the order decide an outcome (the
first target, a tie-break).

**Fix.**

```csharp
// Before
var target = candidates.First();          // HashSet<Unit>
// After
var target = candidates.OrderBy(u => u.Id).First();
```

**Suppress.** When the result does not depend on order (a sum).

### SCN306

**Severity:** warning · **Source:** scan

**Message:** `{0} seeds randomness from GetHashCode ({1}).` **Hint:** `Use a fixed seed (recipe Seed or
Determinism.SeedFor).`

**Cause.** `new Random(name.GetHashCode())`: string hash codes change between processes in .NET.

**Fix.** Use a stable hash or `Determinism.SeedFor(path, order)`.

**Suppress.** Not recommended.

### SCN307

**Severity:** warning · **Source:** scan

**Message:** `{0} creates a Guid ({1}); it changes every run.` **Hint:** `Use a counter or a seeded id.`

**Cause.** `Guid.NewGuid()` in game logic or state.

**Fix.** Use a counter or an id derived from the seed.

**Suppress.** For ids that never enter state or output (telemetry session ids).

## See also

- [Find non-determinism](/scion/41664431a8f5/determinism/diagnose/)
- [diagnose](/scion/41664431a8f5/cli/diagnose/)
- [Clock, screen and random](/scion/41664431a8f5/determinism/clock-and-screen/)
- [Diagnostics](/scion/41664431a8f5/reference/diagnostics/)
